title: Flat-back actuator with plain friction rail clamp
status: Review prototype: consult current validation and service reports; physical fit, strength and force unvalidated

bom.name: Rigid shaft clamp cap
bom.note: Option A: flush-T rail wings, solid center and no offset support. Rail at cap end, Z26 screw center; X12 common outer face. Four-fastener collar fit and loaded retention unvalidated.

bom.name: Fixed jaw, sliding track and shaft saddle
bom.note: Hard rear datum and one broad angular band cleat; the removable cap carries the actuator rail.

bom.name: Sliding opposing jaw
bom.note: T-shaped jaw has two pads 100 mm apart, a midpoint-closing tongue, 4 mm retaining lips and one broad angular band cleat. Turn the phone end-for-end for originally far-side buttons; 66–86 mm width is a geometric range, not qualified.

bom.name: Flat-back plunger frame and offset rail bracket
bom.note: Smoothly blended reinforcement. Mount bore offset 4.4 mm for a common flat back, preserving 5.4 mm beside the bore. No rail locating lugs: one screw/nut clamps the flat face; friction alone resists sliding and rotation. Unchanged rail. Remove nut/screw, withdraw 4.5 mm, lower 2 mm, then withdraw. Strength and retention unqualified.

bom.name: Rounded-shoe sliding plunger
bom.note: Shoe and blended root share the stem thickness of 4 mm; contact span remains 16 mm. Shared capped band/twine cleat. Nominal stroke is illustrative, not a physical force limit.

bom.name: Twine redirect pulley
bom.note: User-approved wheel geometry, raised 2 mm on the remaining boss. Nominal 1 mm axial clearance between boss and axle head; 0.6 mm diametral axle clearance. New mounted behavior untested.

bom.name: Headed smooth pulley axle
bom.note: Unchanged 20.6 mm overall span, 8 mm shaft and outboard cross-key. Now supported by one 8.2 mm boss; head retains the wheel. Cantilever loading and new stack clearance require physical testing.

bom.name: Pulley axle cross-key
bom.note: Uniform 3 mm head/stem thickness with transverse retaining shoulder. Small keeper band encircles key and axle to resist key drift; verify retention and inspect band wear.

bom.name: Coarse printed rail screw
bom.note: One central friction rail clamp, without locating lugs. Successful 8 mm major / 3 mm pitch thread and head retained; obsolete contact nose removed. Changed part and loaded clamp retention unqualified.

bom.name: Long-grip printed collar screw
bom.note: Same 8×3 profile and head, 32 mm threaded span with flush tip; new length is not physically validated.

bom.name: Printed clamp nut
bom.note: Matches successful 8×3 trial nut, including entry lead-ins. Hand-tighten only; loaded retention remains untested.

bom.name: Duel captive guide
bom.note: Install nearest the harness; select the eye facing the actuator. Two 8 mm bores with flared entrances.

bom.name: Captive shaft guide
bom.note: Band-held open saddle with reinforced D-shaped lug; 8 mm bore, 11 mm flared mouths. Smooth the twine-contact surfaces.

bom.name: Twine sections joined by inline band
bom.note: Two lengths joined with a rubber band along the neck. Run directly from the pulley to the nearest shaft guide; there are no bracket guide holes; leave enough for knots. Cord-clearance checks use the provisional 2 mm diameter; actual twine, knots and larger diameters need qualification.

bom.name: Rubber bands
bom.note: 2 jaw closing + 3 guides + 1 return + 1 inline overtravel + 1 axle-key keeper. Actual preload and loop count need fitting.
